create_SubjectLoader_for_training: create a SubjectLoader instance to load NeRF synthetic training data for a specific subject and split
create_SubjectLoader_for_evaluation: create a SubjectLoader instance to load NeRF synthetic test or validation data without ray sampling
call_fetch_data: call fetch_data on a SubjectLoader to get rgba images and camera rays for a given camera index
call_preprocess: call preprocess on a SubjectLoader to composite RGBA images with background colors and sample rays
call_load_renderings: call _load_renderings to load images, camera-to-world matrices, and focal length from a NeRF synthetic dataset
